id.title: Combined method ID
id.description: A unique identifier for one method/citation pairing, formed as the `method_id`, a `.`, and the `citation_method_id`. A `0` in the second position means the method has no citation. Derived, so both halves are also available as their own properties.

method_id.title: Method ID
method_id.description: The RLMS method code. Shared by every row describing the same method.

method_type.title: Method type
method_type.description: Method type for measured or collected data.

method_name.title: Method name
method_name.description: A short name that partially describes the method.

method_description.title: Method description
method_description.description: A long name that fully describes the method.

method_category.title: Method category
method_category.description: Code representing the method category standard.

method_category_name.title: Method category name
method_category_name.description: Name representing the method category standard.

method_category_description.title: Method category description
method_category_description.description: Full description of the method category as defined by the USGS Water Mission Area standards for field and analytical methods and their fit-for-purpose use internally and for public delivery.

citation_method_id.title: Citation method ID
citation_method_id.description: Citation method identification number. Null when the method has no citation, in which case the `id` ends in `.0`.

citation_name.title: Citation name
citation_name.description: Method citation name — an abbreviated citation that describes the reference. Null when the method-citation record names none.

citation_method_number.title: Citation method number
citation_method_number.description: A number assigned to a method within a cited reference.

citation_description.title: Citation description
citation_description.description: Method citation description. Null when the method has no citation, and also when the method-citation record names a citation with no matching record in the citations reference list.
